verdict.rationale: The evidence implies Clerk separates non-production from production setups. The MCP account tools can 'set up production instances', `clerk deploy` ships auth to production as a distinct step, and agent registration can provision an accountless application with keys. Webhook deliveries can also be relayed to a local handler for offline testing. None of this explicitly documents a sandbox or development instance whose data is isolated from production. Missing for 10: explicit docs on development/test instances and their data isolation from production, test users or test credentials, and independent or hands-on confirmation that agents can test safely without touching production data.
